rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: AWS-maintained MCP server that enables AI assistants to work with NIST's Open Security Controls Assessment Language (OSCAL). The server provides tools for schema access, model discovery, resource listing, documentation queries, and component definitions. Supports all eight GA OSCAL models across control, implementation, and assessment layers with built-in validation and integrity verification.
